description:
<!-- Modified by lavinhoque33, 2026-11-18. -->
## YouTube

- **Glass miniplayer:** Minimal and Minimal 2 can match the Glass navigation bar, including its opacity. Turn the effect off under **RVX Settings → Player → Miniplayer → Glass miniplayer**. The switch appears when a supported Minimal style and the Glass navigation bar are active. Adapted from [Ramik4’s Morphe implementation](https://github.com/MorpheApp/morphe-patches/pull/4801). (#63)
- **Minimize animation:** Removed the late resize in the rebuilt Minimal miniplayers without slowing the slide. (#64)
- **Change start page:** Renamed **Library** to **You** without changing its destination or restoring the old navigation tab. Removed Explore, Trending, Podcasts, and Hype from the picker. Shopping remains. (#54)
- **Snack bar:** Set corner radius, separate light and dark fills, and border color and width under **RVX Settings → General → Snack bar**. The same radius can optionally apply to the playlist bottom bar. Previously patched custom colors need to be entered again. (#65)

## YouTube Music

- **Overlay filters:** **Hide overlay filter** and **Hide player overlay filter** are separate switches under **RVX Settings → Player**. Both default off; the double-tap setting is unchanged. (#65)

Repatch with **RVX Patches v1.41.0** in Morphe Manager to get these changes. The new appearance settings can then be changed in the apps without repatching.
